description: This is a Java source file defining the GroovyUtil class, which provides utility methods for evaluating Groovy scripts, loading script classes from locations, parsing classes, and executing scripts within the Apache OFBiz framework.

classes.name: GroovyUtil
classes.description: A utility class for evaluating, loading, parsing, and executing Groovy scripts within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: eval
methods.description: Evaluates a Groovy expression with a given context and returns the result.

methods.name: getBinding
methods.description: Creates a Groovy Binding object initialized with variables from the provided context and expression.

methods.name: getScriptClassFromLocation
methods.description: Loads and caches a Groovy script class from a specified location.

methods.name: parseClass
methods.description: Parses a Groovy class from an InputStream.

methods.name: parseClass
methods.description: Parses a Groovy class from a String containing Groovy code.

methods.name: runScriptAtLocation
methods.description: Executes a Groovy script at a specified location, optionally invoking a method within it, with a given context.
